Results.ReviewText:

 I really enjoy the pizza stone upgrade it makes the best pizza & crust, everyone wants one.
Weber needs to be better at cooking instructions for the burner settings, it’s the only downside.
I learned a lot from actual users on YouTube regarding indirect heating & searing. 
Best grill I’ve ever owned.

Results.ReviewText: We recently downsized and decided not to bring our old Weber Genesis B with us.  We donated it to a neighbor.  Instead we ordered this Spirit E-325, which is the perfect size for our new lifestyle.  I like the fact that both shelves can flip down, saving space while not in use.  We also appreciate the sear zone feature.  But be careful with that - the grill gets super hot so keep away from your plants and siding!

Results.ReviewText: First gas Weber ever and we love it!! Bought it at our local ACE as a Father’s Day gift to myself and we couldn’t be happier! Built and delivered to my house and every meal cooked on it has been successful, fun, and reliable!! I suspect that this grill will outlive me…and I turn 60 in September! Should have invested in a better grill like this years ago, but I’m happy I did now! Bought a durable Weber cover, also, and it’s the most water repellent cover ever! Thank you, Weber! I will be a customer until the end!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had great luck with the grill thus far.  However,  I was under the impression Weber made a full-width griddle insert- which is what their AI “Smokey Joe” (should be named Smokey Joke) told me.  I also referenced the guidelines on which grills they should fit via the griddle inserts themselves.  I’ve since bought two griddle inserts, neither of which fit, and will now be returned.  The main reason I spent extra money on Weber was to have a solid grill by a solid name to get accessories make to fit *this* grill.  Now, I’m faced with having to buy a small griddle that only take us half the space, or go the Amazon route to try to get what I want, which makes me question why I spent so much more in the first place.  This may be my first and last Weber gas grill.
Results.Title: Great grill, accessories questionable.

Results.ReviewText: I bought a Weber because I believed it was a good company with quality products. I used the grill 3 times. On the fourth use, as soon as I started to turn the propane on I could hear a hiss and smell gas. Finding the Weber website to report the issue wasn't the problem. The problem was trying to contact Weber customer service--definitely not a user friendly process. After a lot of frustration, I finally found a form to fill out and submitted it. I immediately got a response, which requested that I submit a clear photo of the black ring in the propane tank. Once again, I got an immediate response that said I would be shipped a replacement part and would received it within 3-5 business days upon notification of shipping. That was three weeks ago and I have never been given any shipping notification information.  Every time I try to check status on the Weber website, I get a message that says: "For technical reasons, your request could not be handled properly at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience." If it was easier to report a problem and get a replacement part, I would have given 4 stars instead of 1. Also, the plastic connections cheapened an otherwise nice product.
Results.Title: Cheap plastic gas line connection

Results.ReviewText: I think the Weber Spirit is great. It has all the benefits of the bigger grills and same power.
Results.Title: Small grill cooks great!!!
